clips.title: The story
paras: Near Ratchet, Tazan carries a locked satchel as he deals with pirates along the coast. The Shattered Hand wants the secret information inside.

Tazan deals with pirates camped along the Barrens coast near Ratchet. Therzok, a guild master of the Shattered Hand beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, takes notice. The guild seeks covert power beyond Warchief Thrall's cautious diplomacy, and marks Tazan for elimination to seize the intelligence in his satchel.
